title: b4 with the patatt fork
description: b4 imports patatt as a library. Show b4 am verifying a registry-signed patch when the fork is installed in place of patatt (pip install from the fork's git-vouch branch) and keyringsrc = vouch:. Document the install and config.
acceptance_criteria: Scripted check: b4 am on a patch series signed with a registry key reports the attestation as passing; a revoked key reports failing.
notes: Review round: misc/vouch-check.sh in ~/PROJECT/b4 now works on RELEASED b4 (verified against an upstream/master ce4c115 src tree and against the git-vouch branch HEAD). No dependency on the unsent vouch-mzkw.9 commits: pass case greps plain 'Signed: openssh/alice@example.org' (no '(key: vouch:' label), and each b4 am first removes $XDG_DATA_HOME/b4 (b4's patatt verdict store lives in get_data_dir(), not the cache dir) instead of setting attestation-recheck-hours. Header documents recheck-hours only as the pending, unsent b4 change (matches DESIGN.md Limits). Pass case now requires a tick on both [PATCH n/2] lines, the Signed line, and no BADSIG/No key; b4 prints one deduplicated Signed line for a series, so per-patch Signed counting does not work. Mutation checks: a tampered 0002 patch now FAILs; dropping the store clear makes the revoked case FAIL on stock b4.
